title: Budget meeting moved
script:
Man: Hi, Lisa. Did you see the email about moving the budget meeting?
Woman: I did. It's been pushed back to Wednesday instead of Monday, right?
Man: That's right. Mr. Ortiz will be traveling on Monday, so he asked to change it.
Woman: Okay. Is the room changing too?
Man: No, we're still in Conference Room B. But the meeting now starts an hour earlier, at nine.
Woman: Got it. I'll go through the financial results beforehand so we can save time.
translation:
男性:やあ、リサ。予算会議の日程変更のメール見た?
女性:見たわ。月曜から水曜に延びたのよね?
男性:そう。オルティスさんが月曜は出張だから、変えてほしいと言われたんだ。
女性:わかった。部屋も変わるの?
男性:いや、会議室Bのままだよ。ただ、開始が1時間早くなって9時だ。
女性:了解。時間を節約できるように、先に財務の結果を確認しておくわ。

questions.question: Why was the budget meeting moved?
choices: A senior manager will be away on Monday.
The conference room was double-booked.
A client asked for a later date.
The financial report was not ready.
questions.explanation: 月曜日にオルティス氏が出張するため、日程を水曜に変えた。

questions.question: What will the woman do before the meeting?
choices: Book a different room.
Review the financial results.
Travel to Mr. Ortiz's office.
Email the director.
questions.explanation: 財務の結果を先に確認しておくと言っている。

questions.question: What has changed about the meeting, other than the day?
choices: The room.
The attendees.
The start time.
The topic.
questions.explanation: 会議室は同じで、開始が1時間早い9時になった。

title: Office supplies delivery
script:
Woman: Hi, Kevin. I'm calling about the office supplies order we placed on Friday. Has it shipped yet?
Man: Let me check. Yes, it left our warehouse this morning. It should arrive by Thursday.
Woman: Good. Could you make sure it includes extra toner cartridges? We ran out last week.
Man: I see them on the order, two cartridges in addition to the paper and pens.
Woman: Great. Our office manager will be out on Thursday, so please deliver to the front desk instead of the back door.
Man: No problem. I'll update the delivery note.
translation:
女性:こんにちは、ケビン。金曜日に注文した事務用品について電話しています。もう発送されましたか?
男性:確認しますね。はい、今朝倉庫を出ました。木曜日までには届くはずです。
女性:よかった。トナーのカートリッジを必ず入れてもらえますか?先週切らしてしまったんです。
男性:注文に入っていますね。紙とペンに加えて、カートリッジが2本です。
女性:助かります。木曜日はオフィス管理者が外出するので、裏口ではなく受付に届けてください。
男性:わかりました。納品書を直しておきますね。

questions.question: What does the man say about the order?
choices: It was delivered last week.
It is still waiting for payment.
It has already been dispatched.
It has been canceled.
questions.explanation: 今朝倉庫を出たと言っている。

questions.question: Why does the woman want toner included?
choices: Their printer is new.
They need it for a client presentation.
They have run out of it.
The supplier forgot it last time.
questions.explanation: 先週切らしてしまったと言っている。

questions.question: Where should the delivery be left on Thursday?
choices: At the back door.
At the loading dock.
At the reception area.
At the office manager's home.
questions.explanation: 木曜日は管理者が外出するため、受付に届けるよう頼んでいる。

title: Printer repair
script:
Man: Hey, the color printer on the fourth floor is jammed again.
Woman: Again? That's the third time this month. Did you call the service company?
Man: I did. They said the part that keeps failing is on back order, so they can't fix it until next week.
Woman: Then let's send the marketing team's jobs to the second-floor printer. Can you put up a sign?
Man: Sure. Actually, the second-floor printer has run out of toner, so I'd rather send them to the copy center.
Woman: That's a long walk. How about I order toner today? It should be here by Thursday.
Man: Thursday's fine. I'll put up the sign and let marketing know.
translation:
男性:ねえ、4階のカラープリンターがまた紙詰まりしているよ。
女性:また?今月3回目ね。サービス会社には連絡した?
男性:した。何度も壊れる部品は取り寄せ中で、来週まで直せないそうだ。
女性:じゃあ、マーケティングチームの印刷は2階のプリンターに回しましょう。張り紙をしてもらえる?
男性:いいよ。ただ、2階のプリンターはトナーが切れているから、コピーセンターに行ってもらったほうがいいと思う。
女性:それは遠いわね。今日トナーを注文しようか?木曜日までには届くはずよ。
男性:木曜日なら大丈夫。張り紙をして、マーケティングに伝えておくよ。

questions.question: What is the problem with the fourth-floor printer?
choices: It needs new paper.
It has broken down several times recently.
It is too slow for marketing's work.
It was moved to the second floor.
questions.explanation: 今月3回目の紙詰まりで、部品の取り寄せが必要になっている。

questions.question: Why will the marketing team not use the second-floor printer right away?
choices: It has run out of ink.
It is being repaired.
It is located too far away.
Its service contract has expired.
questions.explanation: 2階のプリンターはトナーが切れている。

questions.question: What is most likely to happen by Thursday?
choices: The fourth-floor printer will be repaired.
A new printer will be installed.
The marketing team will move to another floor.
The second-floor printer will be ready to use.
questions.explanation: 木曜日にトナーが届くので、2階のプリンターが使えるようになる。

title: Offsite venue price
script:
Man: Julia, the venue for the offsite is confirmed, but the price went up.
Woman: How much more? We had budgeted for the lakeside resort.
Man: About twenty percent. They added a fee for the lake room, but the garden room is still at the original price.
Woman: The garden room only holds forty, and forty-five people are coming.
Man: Right. Five people could use the overflow room with a projector, but the presenters want the big screen.
Woman: Then let's ask the presenters to send their slides ahead so they can be shown in the smaller room. Do the lake and garden rooms share a kitchen?
Man: I believe they do. That's a good question for the resort.
translation:
男性:ジュリア、研修旅行の会場は決まったけど、値段が上がったんだ。
女性:どのくらい増えたの?湖畔のリゾートを想定して予算を組んでいたのよ。
男性:2割くらいだね。湖の部屋に追加料金がかかったけど、庭の部屋は元の値段のままなんだ。
女性:庭の部屋は40人までなのに、45人が来るのよ。
男性:そうなんだ。あふれる5人はプロジェクター付きの別室に入れるけど、発表者は大きいスクリーンを希望している。
女性:じゃあ、発表者にスライドを先に送ってもらって、小さい部屋で映せるようにしましょう。湖の部屋と庭の部屋は台所を共有しているの?
男性:共有していると思う。それはリゾートに聞いてみるべきだね。

questions.question: What is the problem with the lakeside venue?
choices: It is too far from the office.
Its price is now higher.
It has no projector.
It is not available on the planned date.
questions.explanation: 湖の部屋に追加料金がかかり、会場の値段が約2割上がった。

questions.question: Why can the garden room not be used as it is?
choices: It lacks a kitchen.
It costs more than the lake room.
It is closed that week.
It is too small for the group.
questions.explanation: 庭の部屋は40人までで、45人が参加するため。

questions.question: What does the woman suggest the presenters do?
choices: Send their slides ahead for the smaller room's screen.
Give their talks in the lake room.
Bring their own projectors.
Cancel their presentations.
questions.explanation: 事前にスライドを送り、小さい部屋のスクリーンで映せるようにすることを提案している。

title: Shipment invoice mismatch
script:
Man: Hi, this is Tom from Brightline Logistics. We're calling about invoice 4471.
Woman: Yes, I have it here. We were billed for forty cartons, but I only signed for thirty-six.
Man: That's odd. Our driver's log says forty were loaded. Did anyone check the seal on the truck?
Woman: The seal was intact, but four cartons were stacked in the wrong bay, so the receiving team might have missed them.
Man: If they were never unloaded, they'd still be on the truck. I'll ask the driver to take a photo of the bay.
Woman: Please do. Our policy is that we only pay for what we receive. If the photo shows the cartons are there, we'll arrange a second delivery.
translation:
男性:もしもし、ブライトライン物流のトムです。請求書4471番の件でお電話しました。
女性:はい、手元にあります。40箱分の請求が来ていますが、受け取りにサインしたのは36箱だけです。
男性:妙ですね。ドライバーの記録では40箱積んだことになっています。トラックの封印は確認しましたか?
女性:封印は無事でした。ただ、4箱が違う保管場所に積まれていて、受け入れの担当者が見落としたのかもしれません。
男性:降ろされていないなら、まだトラックに載ったままのはずです。保管場所の写真を撮ってもらうよう、ドライバーに頼みます。
女性:お願いします。当社は受け取った分しか支払わない方針です。写真で箱があることが確認できたら、追加の配送を手配しましょう。

questions.question: What does the woman suggest may have happened to the four cartons?
choices: They were damaged during the drive.
They were placed somewhere the receiving team did not look.
They were loaded onto a different truck.
The driver removed them on the way.
questions.explanation: 受け入れの担当者が見ていない場所に積まれていた可能性を述べている。

questions.question: What does the man ask the driver to do?
choices: Take a photo of the storage area.
Sign a new delivery note.
Check the truck's seal again.
Return to the warehouse.
questions.explanation: 保管場所(bay)の写真を撮ってもらうよう頼んでいる。

questions.question: What will happen if the photo confirms that the cartons are there?
choices: The company will pay for the full order.
Another shipment will be arranged.
The invoice will be canceled.
The truck seal will be replaced.
questions.explanation: 会社は受け取った分しか支払わない。写真で箱があると確認できれば、追加の配送を手配する。

title: Interview scheduling
script:
Woman: Mark, we need to schedule the final interviews for the marketing assistant position.
Man: Sure. Ms. Hayashi can do Tuesday or Thursday afternoons, and Mr. Reid is only free in the mornings.
Woman: The first candidate has classes on Thursdays, so Tuesday afternoon is better for her.
Man: Then the second candidate can take Thursday morning. Is the conference room free on Tuesday?
Woman: It's booked after two. We could use the small room on the fourth floor.
Man: Ms. Hayashi said the fourth-floor elevator is out of service this week, though.
Woman: Then we'll use the lobby area on the first floor. I'll reserve it now.
translation:
女性:マーク、マーケティング補助職の最終面接の日程を決めないといけないわ。
男性:そうだね。林さんは火曜か木曜の午後が空いていて、リード氏は午前しか空いていない。
女性:一人目の候補者は木曜日に授業があるから、火曜の午後のほうがいいわ。
男性:じゃあ、二人目の候補者は木曜の午前にしよう。火曜は会議室が空いている?
女性:2時以降は予約が入っているわ。4階の小さい部屋が使えるかも。
男性:ただ、林さんによると、今週は4階のエレベーターが止まっているらしいよ。
女性:それなら、1階のロビーのスペースを使いましょう。今予約しておくわ。

questions.question: Why is Tuesday afternoon better for the first candidate?
choices: She cannot attend on Thursdays because of her studies.
Mr. Reid is free only on Tuesday.
The conference room is booked on Thursdays.
Ms. Hayashi is traveling on Thursday.
questions.explanation: 一人目の候補者は木曜日に授業があるため、火曜の午後が都合がよい。

questions.question: Where will the interview on Tuesday afternoon most likely be held?
choices: The conference room.
The small room on the fourth floor.
The lobby area on the first floor.
Mr. Reid's office.
questions.explanation: 会議室は2時以降が予約済み、4階はエレベーターが止まっているため、1階のロビーになる。

questions.question: Why does the man mention the fourth-floor elevator?
choices: It is the reason the interview was rescheduled.
It is a problem with Mr. Reid's schedule.
It is a reason to cancel the interviews.
It explains why the small room cannot be used.
questions.explanation: 4階の小さい部屋を使えない理由として、エレベーターの故障を挙げている。

title: Office move and delays
script:
Man: Ana, the facilities team says the move to the new building is still scheduled for the fifteenth.
Woman: I heard. But half the sales team is still waiting for their desks to be set up.
Man: That's what worries me. Facilities promised to finish by Friday, though.
Woman: They said that last week too. If they finish on Friday, we'd still have the weekend to unpack, right?
Man: Only if the network works. IT hasn't even tested the cables on the third floor.
Woman: Then I'd rather postpone the sales team and move only the marketing team on the fifteenth.
Man: That could work, but Mr. Chen wants everyone to move at once, to avoid paying storage fees twice.
Woman: Storage fees cost far less than delayed sales. I'll talk to him this afternoon.
translation:
男性:アナ、施設チームによると、新しいビルへの引っ越しは今も15日の予定だそうだ。
女性:聞いたわ。でも、営業チームの半分はまだデスクの設置を待っているのよ。
男性:そこが心配なんだ。ただ、施設チームは金曜までに終えると約束している。
女性:先週もそう言っていたわよね。金曜に終わったとしても、週末に荷ほどきする時間はあるのよね?
男性:ネットワークが使えればね。IT部門は3階のケーブルをまだテストもしていないんだ。
女性:それなら、営業チームの引っ越しを延ばして、15日はマーケティングチームだけを移すほうがいいわ。
男性:それも手だけど、チェン氏は保管料を二重に払わないように、全員を一度に移したいと言っている。
女性:保管料は、営業が止まることに比べたらずっと安いわ。今日の午後に彼と話してみる。

questions.question: What does the man imply about the facilities team?
choices: It has already finished setting up the desks.
It has agreed to pay the storage fees.
Its promise to finish on time may not be kept.
It will test the network this afternoon.
questions.explanation: though で金曜の約束に疑いを示している。女性も、前週に同じことを言っていたと指摘している。

questions.question: Why does the woman prefer her suggestion to Mr. Chen's plan?
choices: It avoids storage fees entirely.
The sales team does not need desks until Friday.
The marketing team has already moved.
Lost sales would outweigh the extra fees.
questions.explanation: 女性は、営業が止まる損失のほうが保管料より大きいと考えている。

questions.question: What will the woman most likely do next?
choices: Talk to Mr. Chen about the plan.
Test the cables on the third floor.
Ask facilities to finish earlier.
Start unpacking the sales team's boxes.
questions.explanation: 今日の午後にチェン氏と話すと言っている。

title: Museum closure message
script:
Narrator: Hello, you have reached Harbor Museum visitor services.
Narrator: The east wing is closed for a structural inspection until the end of next month. The special exhibition in the west wing remains open, but its entrance has moved to the parking garage on Pine Street.
Narrator: Members who booked east-wing tickets can switch them to west-wing tickets on our website or at the front desk. The switch must be made before the end of this month. Thank you for your patience.
translation:
案内:ハーバー美術館の来館者窓口です。
案内:東翼は構造検査のため、来月末まで閉鎖しています。西翼の特別展は引き続き開催していますが、入口がパインストリートの駐車場ビルに移りました。
案内:東翼のチケットをお持ちの会員の方は、当館のウェブサイトか受付で西翼のチケットに変更できます。変更は今月末までにお願いします。ご不便をおかけしますが、よろしくお願いします。

questions.question: Why is the east wing closed?
choices: It is being repainted for a new exhibition.
It has been sold to a private company.
It is being checked for safety.
Its entrance is under construction.
questions.explanation: 構造検査のため閉鎖している。構造検査は安全の点検にあたる。

questions.question: What must members do before the end of this month?
choices: Pay a fee to keep their east-wing tickets.
Move their reservations from the east wing to the west wing.
Visit the café to receive a refund.
Register at the parking garage on Pine Street.
questions.explanation: 東翼の予約を西翼に変更する必要がある。期限は今月末。

questions.question: What is the main inconvenience for visitors to the west wing?
choices: They must enter at a different location than usual.
They cannot buy food on site.
The special exhibition has ended.
They have to pay extra for parking.
questions.explanation: 西翼の特別展は開催中だが、入口が駐車場ビルに移った。

title: Catering price change
script:
Man: Rina, I just saw the caterer's new quote for the awards dinner. It's higher than what we agreed on in March.
Woman: I know. They've started charging for drinks separately. Before, drinks were included in the price per guest.
Man: The executive office won't approve anything over the original budget. Could we just cut the guest list?
Woman: I'm afraid not. The director has already promised a hundred and twenty seats to our sponsors.
Man: Then what about the dessert course? We could replace it with coffee and cookies.
Woman: I suggested that, but the caterer said dessert isn't where the cost went up. It's only the drinks.
Man: Well, the hotel next door offered us free drinks last year if we booked their ballroom.
Woman: That offer ended in June. I'd rather ask the caterer whether the March price can still apply, since we signed our contract before they changed their pricing.
Man: Good point. The contract should be in the shared folder. I'll find it before you call them.
translation:
男性:リナ、授賞式ディナーのケータリングの新しい見積もりを見たよ。3月に合意した額より高くなっている。
女性:知っているわ。飲み物を別料金にし始めたの。前は、飲み物は1人あたりの料金に含まれていたのに。
男性:役員室は、当初の予算を超えるものは承認しないよ。招待客を減らせばいいんじゃないかな?
女性:残念だけど、それは無理。部長がもうスポンサーに120席を約束しているの。
男性:それなら、デザートのコースはどう?コーヒーとクッキーに替えられるよ。
女性:それも提案したけど、値上がりしたのはデザートではないとケータリング会社に言われたわ。飲み物だけなの。
男性:そういえば、去年は隣のホテルが、宴会場を予約すれば飲み物を無料にすると言っていたよ。
女性:その特典は6月で終わったわ。それより、3月の料金がまだ適用されるかをケータリング会社に聞いてみたいの。料金を変える前に契約を結んだのだから。
男性:いい点だね。契約書は共有フォルダにあるはずだ。君が電話する前に探しておくよ。

questions.question: Why has the cost of the dinner increased?
choices: The dessert course has become more expensive.
The dinner has been moved to a hotel ballroom.
More sponsors have been invited to the dinner.
The caterer now charges separately for drinks.
questions.explanation: 女性が「They've started charging for drinks separately」と言い、後でも「It's only the drinks」と念を押している。デザートは「dessert isn't where the cost went up」と否定されている。ホテルの宴会場は過去の話で、招待客は増えていない(120席はもともとの約束)。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'm afraid not"?
choices: The number of guests cannot be reduced.
She does not know how many guests are coming.
The sponsors have not replied to the invitation.
She thinks the budget limit is too strict.
questions.explanation: 「Could we just cut the guest list?」への返事で、直後に「部長がもうスポンサーに120席を約束している」と理由を続けている。つまり招待客は減らせないという意味。人数が分からない、返事がない、予算が厳しすぎるとは言っていない。

questions.question: Why does the woman think the March price might still apply?
choices: The hotel next door has offered free drinks again.
The contract was signed before the caterer changed its prices.
The director has promised seats to the sponsors.
The caterer offered the company a discount in June.
questions.explanation: 女性は「since we signed our contract before they changed their pricing」と理由をはっきり述べている。ホテルの特典は「That offer ended in June」で終わっており、June はこの特典の話でケータリング会社の割引ではない。スポンサーへの約束は、招待客を減らせない理由。

title: Warehouse delay talk
script:
Narrator: Good morning, everyone, and thank you for joining the quarterly review.
Narrator: Before we begin, I need to correct something I said in last week's report. I told you the warehouse upgrade would finish on schedule. Unfortunately, the contractor has now told us that the new loading equipment won't arrive until the end of the month.
Narrator: As a result, shipments planned for next week will go out two weeks later than scheduled. The good news is that our largest client, Fenwick Foods, has agreed to accept a smaller first delivery from our old warehouse, so their stores won't run out of stock.
Narrator: Haruka in logistics will send the revised delivery routes to our drivers at noon today. So, if any of your customers can't accept the new delivery dates, please tell her before then.
translation:
ナレーター:皆さん、おはようございます。四半期の報告会にご参加いただきありがとうございます。
ナレーター:始める前に、先週の報告でお伝えしたことを訂正しなければなりません。倉庫の改修は予定どおり終わるとお伝えしました。しかし残念ながら、新しい積み込み設備は月末まで届かないと、施工業者から連絡がありました。
ナレーター:このため、来週予定していた出荷は、予定より2週間遅れて出ることになります。良い知らせもあります。最大の取引先である Fenwick Foods が、旧倉庫からの少なめの初回納品を受け入れることに同意してくれたので、同社の店舗で在庫が切れることはありません。
ナレーター:物流部のハルカが、今日の正午に新しい配送経路を運転手に送ります。ですから、新しい納品日では受け取れない顧客がいる場合は、それまでに彼女に伝えてください。

questions.question: What information in last week's report was incorrect?
choices: That the new loading equipment had already arrived.
That Fenwick Foods had decided to cancel its order.
That shipments would be delayed by two weeks.
That the warehouse upgrade would be completed on time.
questions.explanation: 話し手は先週の報告を訂正すると言い、「I told you the warehouse upgrade would finish on schedule」と誤っていた内容を挙げている。2週間の遅れは今回の新しい情報で、先週の報告の内容ではない。設備が届いた、Fenwick Foods が注文を取り消したとは言っていない。

questions.question: Why does the speaker mention Fenwick Foods?
choices: To introduce a new client that the company has just signed.
To explain how a client will avoid running out of products.
To explain why the new loading equipment will be late.
To announce that a client has moved to another supplier.
questions.explanation: 「has agreed to accept a smaller first delivery ..., so their stores won't run out of stock」と、取引先が在庫切れを避けられることを伝えている。Fenwick Foods は「our largest client」で新しい取引先ではない。設備が遅れる理由(施工業者の連絡)とは関係がない。

questions.question: Why should listeners contact Haruka before noon?
choices: The contractor will visit the warehouse at that time.
Fenwick Foods needs an answer from the company by then.
The old warehouse will close for the day at that time.
She will send the new routes to the drivers at that time.
